column1: # Mirror of stock WLED's 4MB ESP32 partition table (WLED_ESP32_4MB_1MB_FS).
# Used by env:gledopto309 (the no-USB backup board): its first flash of our
# firmware goes through stock WLED's OTA updater
# app — the factory partition table stays on the flash forever (redrawing it
# needs a wire). So the build must size-check against WLED's 1.5MB app slot
# not our custom 1.875MB table (partitions_cube.csv). At runtime the table
# on the chip governs; this file exists for checkprogsize + documentation.
